subject: QBR readiness: launch runbook, delta exposures, and mitigation owners
messages:
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>, Emma Li <emma@acmeanalytics.com>, Tom Garcia <t.garcia@acmeanalytics.com>
Cc: 
Date: 2026-11-07T09:02:00-08:00
Subject: QBR readiness: launch runbook, delta exposures, and mitigation owners

Team / Emma & Tom,

We need a concise QBR-ready summary of where we stand on the upcoming Product Launch (target window: 2027-01-18 -> 2027-01-25). The execs want a single slide and a 1-page risk appendix showing the current exposures and named owners by our QBR on 2026-11-10. Please reply with short, owner-verified bullets by EOD Monday. Key asks: 

- One-line current status (Green / Yellow / Red) for each of: Serving Runtime, Model Packaging & Quantization, Console/Telemetry, Partner Integrations (Acme).
- Top 5 open risks that can change launch timing (explicit failure mode + impact).
- Mitigation owner and ETA for each.
- Any gating exceptions you expect to request (describe and justify).

I attached a draft runbook and the runway risk matrix for reference (qbr_launch_runbook_v2.xlsx, runway_risk_matrix.pdf). Laura / Karthik / Hannah -- can you confirm owners and short mitigation plans for the items below? Emma / Tom -- I included Acme to flag any external integration constraints you expect.

Preliminary items I have flagged: 
1) Model quantization path: experiment showed 12% perf regression on long-context tests (impact: tail latency + p99). Owner: Karthik.
2) KV cache correctness regression in multi-tenant test environment (impact: consistency & customer correctness). Owner: Laura.
3) Console telemetry gap for token-level cost breakdown (impact: billing disputes if not present at GA). Owner: Hannah.
4) Partner auth/SCIM for Acme SSO (impact: blocked onboarding for initial account). External owner: Acme / Tom.

Thanks — short bullets please. I will consolidate for the QBR slide.

Best,
Vivek
SVP, Product & Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachments: qbr_launch_runbook_v2.xlsx (spreadsheet, 78KB), runway_risk_matrix.pdf (document, 120KB)

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>, Emma Li <emma@acmeanalytics.com>, Tom Garcia <t.garcia@acmeanalytics.com>
Cc: 
Date: 2026-11-07T14:18:00-08:00
Subject: Re: QBR readiness: launch runbook, delta exposures, and mitigation owners

Vivek —

Short status bullets below (owner + ETA). Keeping this tight for the slide.

Serving Runtime: Yellow — throughput tests at target QPS hit in 90% of runs; p99 still 60ms above target on long sequences. Owner: Karthik; ETA for kernel tuning + hotfix: 2026-11-22.

Model Packaging & Quantization: Yellow — quantization experiments show a 12% quality delta on long-context prompt sets; we're validating a mixed-precision fallback path. Owner: Karthik; ETA for validated fallback + retrain: 2026-12-08.

KV Cache Consistency: Red (high) — multi-tenant regression reproduces in 2 of 3 clusters; root cause points to sharding boundary handling. Owner: Laura; ETA for patch + canary: 2026-11-18. Contingency: rollback to previous cache schema if necessary (would add ~250ms latency).

Console / Telemetry: Yellow — missing token-level cost breakdown in billing stream for early customers. Owner: Hannah; ETA for incremental rollout of token attribution: 2026-11-30. Risk: billing disputes; mitigation: pre-GA crediting policy.

Partner (Acme) integration: Yellow — SSO/SCIM handshake pending cert update from Acme; blocking initial onboarding until 2027-01-10 unless certs shared. External contact: Tom Garcia.

Gating exceptions we will likely request: 
- Allow telemetry to be incomplete at GA with committed billing credits for Acme pilot accounts.
- Approve a limited rollout with degraded token attribution for non-billing-critical customers.

I've attached a short owner matrix (mitigation_owners.xlsx) with named owners and phone numbers.

--Laura
Laura Bennett
VP, Engineering (Serving Runtime)
Redwood Inference

Attachment: mitigation_owners.xlsx (spreadsheet, 24KB)

Date: 2026-11-08T11:46:00-08:00
Subject: Re: QBR readiness: launch runbook, delta exposures, and mitigation owners

Vivek / team,

Quick technical notes to feed the appendix:

- Quantization: we measured a 12% drop on long-context pass accuracy using int8-only flows. The mitigation is to ship mixed-precision packaging where we run L0/L1 layers in float16 and the remainder int8. Perf trade: +10% latency overhead in worst-case tail; expected to pass SLA after kernel tuning. Canary plan: start mixed-precision canary on 2026-11-24, full rollout 2026-12-08 if metrics hold.

- Serving runtime p99: the dominant contributor is KV cache miss and rehydrate on sharded boundary. Laura's patch to boundary handling reduces cross-node lookups; we estimated a ~180ms reduction after canary.

- Rollout fallback: if mixed-precision shows larger quality delta, plan is automated fallback to float16 for flagged workloads with feature flag and traffic split. That adds complexity to rollout but avoids blocking GA.

Owners & immediate asks: 
- I'll own quantization validation and canary (ETA: 2026-12-08).
- Laura to confirm canary plan for KV patch (ETA: 2026-11-18).
- Hannah to confirm telemetry crediting plan for Acme (Hannah, ETA: 2026-11-30).

FYI: forwarding Hannah's timeline suggestion below — Hannah, please confirm if these dates are viable.

> From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>
> Date: 2026-11-08T10:55:00-08:00
> Subject: QBR telemetry timeline proposal
>
> - 2026-11-12: implement interim token attribution for pilot accounts (no billing integration).
> - 2026-11-22: iterate on attribution accuracy and add audit logs.
> - 2026-11-30: enable token-level billing pipeline for GA customers.

Thanks,
Karthik

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>, Emma Li <emma@acmeanalytics.com>, Tom Garcia <t.garcia@acmeanalytics.com>

Date: 2026-11-09T16:12:00-08:00
Subject: Re: QBR readiness: launch runbook, delta exposures, and mitigation owners — consolidated decisions

Thanks all for the quick turn. Executive summary for the slide pack (one-liner each):

Serving Runtime — Yellow: kernel & KV fixes in flight; canary planned 11/18; contingency adds latency but preserves correctness. Owner: Laura; action: validated canary run 11/18.

Model Quantization — Yellow: mixed-precision fallback will be the GA strategy if int8 delta persists. Owner: Karthik; action: canary start 11/24, validate by 12/08.

Console Telemetry — Yellow: interim token attribution for pilots by 11/12; GA billing pipeline by 11/30. Owner: Hannah; action: pre-GA credit policy for Acme.

Acme Integration — Yellow: SSO cert deadline 12/15 to avoid onboarding slip; request Acme confirm certs by 11/16. External contact: Tom.

Gating exceptions approved by me for the QBR packet: 
- Limited GA with telemetry credits for early partners (Acme) to avoid blocking launch.
- Automated float16 fallback permitted for flagged workloads during rollout.

Next steps: Laura to share canary run report by 11/19. Karthik to post canary metrics 12/09. Hannah to confirm credit rules and send wording for the QBR slide. Emma/Tom — please acknowledge acceptance of the limited telemetry credit approach by 11/16.

I'll upload the one-slide executive summary and the 1-page risk appendix to the QBR Drive folder after I get Laura's canary note.

Vivek
SVP, Product & Operations
Redwood Inference
